q1.method: find bytes 68+LE32(0x7f7c80) in .text; accept only if (1) the address is an instruction start of the chunked capstone linear sweep, (2) that instruction is push, (3) op_str is exactly 0x7f7c80, (4) insn size==5 so bytes[1:5] are the imm32 operand (not incidental data)
q1.boundary_uniqueness: 37 distinct candidate-start vectors over 60 sites; see distinct_candidate_vectors

ctrl_b_drop_d2_zero_check.remark: as specified this control does NOT come out strictly greater: every d3low==0x00C0 & d4==0x46000000 hit already has d2==0, so the d2 clause adds no selectivity on this file

ctrl_b2_drop_d2_and_d3.rule: drop d2==0 AND drop (d3&0xFFFF)==0x00C0, keep d4==0x46000000

ctrl_b3_drop_d3_only.rule: keep d2==0, drop d3low, keep d4

ctrl_c_anti_0x7f7c94.note: 0x7f7c94 is 0x7f7c80+0x14, i.e. the third dword (d3) of the 0x7f7c80 GUID; it is not a GUID start

ctrl_d_anti_fake_boundary_0x200.rule: function start := site_address-0x200, extent := exactly the following 0x200 bytes
